title: susi task record (.agents/tasks/*.json, .agents/tasks/done/*.json)
description: The shape the task queue, tests/task_records.rs and the distillation planner (xtask/src/distill.rs) read. Historical records carry many more fields, so unknown properties are allowed. A record in done/ or with a `closed` object counts as closed. Labels that let a release select the record: id, deps, scopes, accept.cmd, status, closed.commit or a `Task: <id>` commit trailer, evidence.

dependencies.description: Legacy alternative to deps: task ids, or objects naming a task.

status.description: Free text in history. The planner maps done/closed/completed -> closed; implemented, verified, *_pending_integration, ready_for_integration -> implemented; failed/canceled/abandoned/rejected/retired -> abandoned; anything else -> open.

evidence.description: Repository path(s) of evidence files; the planner requires each to exist at the base revision.

reuse.description: CEO Mandate 78: where the agent looked for existing work before building, and what it decided. `searched` is required in practice: the commit hooks refuse a feature-sized task without it.
